jsonld.headline: A Lipschitz-nonincreasing deformation of small unitary-valued maps
jsonld.description: An explicit deformation of small unitary-valued sphere maps preserves a half-Lipschitz bound, with a quantitative estimate for two intrinsic length metrics.
jsonld.abstract: For the unit-round sphere and either the unnormalized Hilbert–Schmidt or operator-norm length metric on U(N), we give an explicit strong deformation retraction of the maps with Lipschitz constant at most 1/2 onto the constant maps. At time t ∈ [0,1], the Lipschitz constant is at most (1 − t²)/(1 + t²) times its original value. The formula depends continuously on the entire map and stays in the original U(N). In particular, it answers the literal question [?24](i) in Gromov's 2017 scalar-curvature problem list, with the stronger requirement that the Lipschitz bound be preserved throughout. The proof uses a classical matrix fractional transformation and an elementary resolvent identity.
